about: As an associate attorney at the Law Office of Jacob E. Martinez in Denver, Colorado, Tyler B. Selcer is a seasoned advocate in criminal defense. He extends his services to clients across the entire state. His legal practice covers a wide array of areas, including but not limited to:

Hailing from Golden, Colorado, Mr. Selcer's academic journey led him to the University of Colorado at Boulder, where he achieved a trio of bachelor's degrees in international affairs, Spanish literature and political science. He was pivotal as a lead facilitator in the University of Colorado Restorative Justice Program, collaborating with university staff and students to address legal violations through community and victim reconciliation.

Pursuing his passion for law, Mr. Selcer attended the Sturm College of Law – University of Denver, immersing himself in criminal law, criminal procedure, trial practice and constitutional law, culminating in his Juris Doctorate in 2018. That same year, he was licensed in Colorado. His journey with the Law Office of Jacob E. Martinez began in 2015, where he honed his skills in legal research, client communication, and the preparation of motions, briefs, and other critical legal documents.

Post-law school, Mr. Selcer embarked on a new adventure in Savannah, Georgia, becoming a licensed attorney in South Carolina. He broadened his legal horizons at Hilton Head Island, assisting clients with residential and commercial real estate transactions, probate matters, debt mitigation and negotiation, and estate planning.

Mr. Selcer's unwavering dedication to his clients and commitment to justice has earned him a place among the National Trial Lawyers: Top 40 under 40. He is deeply passionate about advocating for those facing criminal charges and understanding the profound impact these charges can have on their lives. With a keen ear, he listens to his clients, exploring potential strategies tailored to each unique case.
